targets.name: P03Q1f.Chain.mapEdge
targets.expected_type_content: Any typed Chain A B maps an A.Edge u v to B.Edge of the composite node images.

targets.name: P03Q1f.walkRank
targets.expected_type_content: Every nonempty Walk A u v strictly increases the topological rank.

targets.name: P03Q1f.Hom.mapWalk
targets.expected_type_content: Any Hom A B preserves a nonempty Walk on its node images.

targets.name: P03Q1f.noClosedWalk
targets.expected_type_content: For every ranked ReasonDAG A and node u, no nonempty Walk A u u exists.

targets.name: P03Q1f.Hom.noCollapseOfWalk
targets.expected_type_content: For any Hom A B and nonempty Walk A u v, the images of u and v differ.
